integrity: Exact enumerations and rational calculations corroborate but do not replace the combinatorial factorial-moment proof. No independent mathematical or historical-priority audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The joint Poisson limit fixes the number of independent orders and a finite list of cycle lengths before taking the carrier size to infinity.
The finite-size identity calculates expected short-cycle counts, not full finite-size distributions.
No full first-order convergence law or quantitative error bound is asserted.
Historical priority may depend on an equivalent conditioning argument for Hamiltonian path superpositions.
title: Exact finite-size and Poisson short-cycle laws for superposed linear-order successors
